The News Application

Overview

The news application is the core component of The Weekly Times. It manages the creation, publication, review, and distribution of news content.

The application supports three main user roles:

  • Journalists: Create and manage their own articles and newsletters.

  • Editors: Review, approve, edit, and manage submitted content.

  • Readers: Browse news content and subscribe to publishers and journalists.

Purpose of the Application

The application provides a platform where journalists can submit news content for editorial review. Editors are responsible for reviewing and approving submitted content before publication.

Readers can access approved news content and subscribe to their preferred publishers and journalists.

The application also provides REST API functionality for accessing approved news content and managing application resources.

Module Reference

This section provides technical documentation for the Python modules that implement the application’s functionality.

News Package

The news package contains the main components of The Weekly Times, including its database models, application views, forms, administrative functionality, permissions, and API implementation.

news.urls module

This module defines the URL patterns for the main news application.

It connects browser requests to the appropriate application views, allowing users to access the different pages and features of The Weekly Times.

Define URL routes for the news application’s web pages.

news.views module

This module contains the main application views.

It handles user requests and manages the functionality associated with displaying articles, managing journalist content, and providing access to the application’s different pages.

It also supports article creation, editing, deletion, and other application operations.

Define the views for The Weekly Times news application.
